name: Mountaineer Stormpike's Task
summary: In Loch Modan, Mountaineer Stormpike needs a runner for business beyond the valley. Mountaineer Kadrell sends travelers to the northern watchtower, where Stormpike waits with an assignment that leads into neighboring lands.

sections.title: A Watchman in Need of a Runner
sections.body: Mountaineer Stormpike watches from the northern guard tower, but his post keeps him from leaving Loch Modan. Mountaineer Kadrell points capable travelers toward guards who cannot leave their duties. With troggs and roaming wildlife threatening the roads and outposts, the Mountaineers have little room to spare. Stormpike needs a messenger for urgent personal business far beyond the region's borders.

sections.title: From Tower to Distant Roads
sections.body: You find Stormpike at the top of the northern guard tower, above the valley. A member of the prominent Stormpike clan, he has affairs beyond the frontier defense of Thelsamar. Carrying his message and supplies means crossing regional borders on his behalf, taking you from the loch onto the highways of Khaz Modan.

faq.q: Where do I find Mountaineer Stormpike?
faq.answer: Mountaineer Stormpike keeps watch from the top of the northern guard tower in Loch Modan, overlooking the surrounding trails.
Mountaineer Kadrell patrols near Thelsamar in Loch Modan and points you toward Stormpike's tower.

faq.q: Why does Stormpike need an adventurer?
faq.answer: Stormpike cannot leave his post at the tower. His personal business takes him well beyond Loch Modan, so he needs a traveler to carry his message.

faq.q: What happens after reporting to Stormpike?
aliases: what comes after mountaineer stormpikes task
faq.answer: Reporting to Stormpike completes this first step and opens his follow-up errand, 'Stormpike's Order', a delivery to another territory.

faq.q: Is this related to the Stormpike Guard in Alterac?
faq.answer: Mountaineer Stormpike shares the name and blood of the Stormpike clan, known for the Stormpike Guard and its mining expeditions. His assignment here is a modest local errand.

faq.q: Do Horde players have an equivalent quest here?
faq.answer: No. Loch Modan is dwarven territory aligned with the Alliance, and its Mountaineers attack Horde travelers on sight.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you may feel a natural duty to help a fellow dwarf of the famed Stormpike line and honor clan ties across Khaz Modan.
As an Alliance traveler, you help regional mountaineers carry dispatches that keep Ironforge's garrisons supplied and coordinated across the eastern territories.
